product: SoilGrids 2.0 global soil property maps, 1 km aggregated layers (data_aggregated/1000m), mean predictions
version: SoilGrids 2.0 (files tagged Code_version v2.0.0, Outputs_version RUN05, WoSIS data stream 7); server Last-Modified 2022-06-02
checksumVerification: All 12 sha256 values match ISRIC's published <var>/checksum.sha256.txt.
nativeGrid: Interrupted Goode Homolosine (custom WKT 'Homolosine', WGS84 datum; ~ESRI:54052), 1000 m pixels, 39812 x 14509, int16, nodata -32768, origin (-19949750, 8361000)

units.note: Values are stored as integers in 'mapped units'. Divide by conversionFactor to get conventional units (ISRIC SoilGrids FAQ table, https://docs.isric.org/globaldata/soilgrids/SoilGrids_faqs_01.html, checked 2026-11-07). The prepared Parquet files keep the mapped units unchanged.

soc.meaning: Soil organic carbon content (fine earth fraction)

clay.meaning: Clay (<0.002 mm) content of fine earth fraction

sand.meaning: Sand (>0.05 mm) content of fine earth fraction

bdod.meaning: Bulk density of the fine earth fraction

uncertainty: No uncertainty (or Q0.05/Q0.95) layers are published in data_aggregated/1000m (directory listing checked 2026-11-07: mean only; nitrogen also has a 5000 m mean). Uncertainty at 250 m exists under https://files.isric.org/soilgrids/latest/data/ and as regional clips in soilgrids_v2/.
masking: SoilGrids leaves urban/built-up areas, water bodies and permanent ice as nodata (e.g. central Phoenix is nodata). Nodata stays null in all derived products.

derived.reprojected: soilgrids_1km/epsg4326/<var>_<depth>_mean_4326.tif via scripts/reproject_to_4326.py: GDAL WarpedVRT, nearest neighbour, EPSG:4326, 1/120 deg (43200 x 21600, -180..180, -90..90), int16, nodata -32768 preserved. Intermediate files, regenerable.
derived.h3: data/prepared/soilgrids_<var>_<depth>_mean_h3r6.parquet via scripts/aggregate_raster_to_h3.py --agg mean (pixel-centre assignment to H3 res 6, unweighted mean of valid pixels; columns h3 uint64, value float32 in mapped units, n_valid).

licence.name: CC BY 4.0
licence.attribution: Poggio, L. et al. (2021) SoilGrids 2.0: producing soil information for the globe with quantified spatial uncertainty. SOIL 7, 217–240. https://doi.org/10.5194/soil-7-217-2021. Data: ISRIC - World Soil Information, SoilGrids 2.0 (CC BY 4.0).
licence.notes: Indicate modification when displaying derived H3 values (reprojected to EPSG:4326 and averaged to H3 resolution 6). Modelled predictions, not measurements.

query: global; variables phh2o, soc, clay, sand, nitrogen, bdod; depths 0-5cm and 15-30cm; statistic mean; 1000 m aggregated product
